chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Mu'azzi, from al-Talisi, from Saif ibn 'Amirah, from Ishaq, from Sa'd ibn 'Abdullah, that he said:
To Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him): 'I pray in the Sacred Mosque, so I sit on my left leg because of the cold.' He said, 'Sit on your two haunches, even if you are in mud.'
ai.seo_question: What is the proper sitting posture for prayer according to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq when one is cold or uncomfortable?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the jurisprudential principle that the integrity of the prayer posture (sujud and sitting positions) supersedes personal comfort or environmental conditions, such as cold or dirt. Imam al-Sadiq’s instruction to sit on both haunches even in mud underscores the Shia emphasis on adhering to the Sunnah of the Prophet’s physical demeanor during prayer, ensuring reverence and stability regardless of external hardships.
